# Offline evaluation policy fixtures

These JSON files exercise dataset identity, cumulative spending, unknown usage,
and policy migration with isolated databases and synthetic model transports.
Approval identities and statements are synthetic. They do not authorize real
API calls, represent human semantic labels, or describe current provider prices.
Numeric policy values are frozen regression inputs, not purchasing guidance.

Real evaluation runners require their own reviewed dataset and explicit local
policy/authorization. Private collaboration records are not distributed.
